strings.game.title: The Umbrella We Shared
strings.char.yuuto.name: Yuuto
strings.char.nao.name: Nao
strings.char.shizuku.name: Shizuku
strings.char.rui.name: Rui
strings.ending.nao_end.title: Disaster Twins
strings.ending.shizuku_end.title: Not Lucky, Only Dry
strings.s01.intro: The rain came down like it had a grudge. I stood under the dripping eave of the bus stop, bag over my head as if that would help, and watched the last bus pull away without me. The timetable and I had never been on speaking terms.
strings.s01.nao.002: You missed it too, huh? Twins — we're disaster twins now.
strings.s01.thunder: Thunder cracked somewhere over the hills, and for half a second her grin slipped into something startled — before snapping right back.
strings.s01.shizuku.006: …The next bus isn't for forty minutes. If you're counting on it.
strings.s01.yuuto.007: A voice from the far end of the bench. I hadn't even noticed her sitting there.
strings.s01.nao.008: See? This one's got the timetable memorized. Hey, Shizuku — share mine when it clears? Yellow's lucky.
strings.s01.rui.009: Nao! There you are! Coach is going to kill us — the meet got moved up—
strings.s01.rui.010: Oh. Sorry. Am I interrupting a thing?
strings.s01.bothspeak: “There's no thing,” Shizuku said — at the exact moment Nao said, “Total thing.”
strings.s01.rui.011: Tell me later! We have to go — the bus on Maple still runs—
strings.s01.gone: And then they were gone, yellow umbrella popping open over both of them — just me, Shizuku, the rain, and forty minutes.
strings.s01.charm: Something glinted on the bench where Nao had been sitting. I picked it up. It was warm.
strings.s01.charm.caption: A little brass charm shaped like a bus, its ring snapped open. Fallen off Nao's bag, probably.
strings.s01.shizuku.014: …Do you want to wait? It's a long forty minutes alone. I have an umbrella too. It's not lucky. But it's dry.
strings.s01.yuuto.015: Forty minutes. A charm to return. A quiet voice, or a loud one. I had to decide which rain to walk into.
strings.choice.umbrella.prompt: Which rain do I walk into?
strings.s01.yuuto.chase: “Wait — Nao! You dropped something!” I bolted out into the downpour after the yellow umbrella.
strings.s01.yuuto.wait: “…Yeah,” I said, and sat down on the dry end of the bench. “A long forty minutes sounds about right.”
strings.s01.shizuku.wait: Good. …I'll hold the umbrella, then. You hold the charm.
strings.s02.intro: By the time the rain thinned, the streetlights had come on, smearing gold across the wet road.
strings.s02.nao.cg: I caught her at the Maple stop, both of us soaked, the yellow umbrella barely covering two heads.
strings.s02.nao.001: You ran all this way to give me back a charm? …Okay, disaster twin. Tomorrow. You're buying me a hot can of something.
strings.s02.shizuku.intro: She shook out her umbrella and peeled off the rain-dark blazer, folding it over her arm.
strings.s02.shizuku.002: …Thank you. For staying. The quiet's easier when it's shared. Walk me to the next stop?
strings.s02.shizuku.cg: We stepped out under one umbrella that wasn't lucky, only dry — and somehow that was better.
